records.title: 10-K
records.text: Total Revenue: Total revenue for 2023 was adversely impacted by the factors described in the section titled “Industry Conditions” above.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The memory and storage industry environment deteriorated sharply in the fourth quarter of 2022 and throughout 2023 due to weak demand in many end markets combined with global and macroeconomic challenges and lower demand resulting from customer actions to reduce inventory levels.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Ongoing demand growth, customer inventory normalization, and industry-wide supply discipline have set the stage for increased revenue, and improved pricing and profitability throughout fiscal 2024.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Sales of DRAM products decreased 51% primarily due to a high-40s percent range decline in average selling prices and decreases in bit shipments in the high-single-digit percent range.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •CNBU operating income (loss) deteriorated primarily due to declines in average selling prices and lower bit shipments.
